methodology.vegetation_index: NDVI: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)
methodology.soil_adjusted_vegetation_index: SAVI: Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index ((NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red + 0.5)) * 1.5
methodology.urban_density: NDBI: Normalized Difference Built-up Index (SWIR1 - NIR) / (SWIR1 + NIR)
methodology.bare_soil_index: BSI: Bare Soil Index ((SWIR1 + Red) - (NIR + Blue)) / ((SWIR1 + Red) + (NIR + Blue))
methodology.water_index: NDWI: Normalized Difference Water Index (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR)
methodology.modified_water_index: MNDWI: Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1)
methodology.moisture_index: NDMI: Normalized Difference Moisture Index (NIR - SWIR1) / (NIR + SWIR1)
methodology.spatial_heterogeneity: Standard Deviation of NDVI within the analysis unit
methodology.spectral_bands: Direct 12-band Sentinel-2 analysis (Vis, NIR, SWIR, RedEdge)
